summary: Evidence notes are filed under their tree (refs/notes/evidence/<tree>/<record>); the verifier, gate and signed-tree job read one tree's prefix instead of every note

schema.detail: No daemon claim or portable record change. The signed statement and the note commit are unchanged; only the ref that points at them is named differently.

rules.detail: scripts/evidence-publish, scripts/ci-evidence-observe and scripts/evidence-wrap create refs/notes/evidence/<tree>/<record> instead of refs/notes/evidence/<record>. scripts/evidence-verify reads both layouts: one prefix listing for the tree, plus the first layout only through a pattern that matches names one object id long. scripts/ci-evidence-gate, scripts/ci-signed-tree and scripts/web-skip-proof fetch the head tree's own prefix (and the input-keyed prefix of a check that has a key) instead of every note. The reason stale_tree is reported only for first-layout refs; a tree-prefixed lookup says no_record. st evidence (crates/st3-kernel) ignores tree-prefixed refs when it lists records instead of failing on them. Every enforce stays false, so no job is skipped or rejected by this change; until scripts/evidence-gc has migrated or removed first-layout notes the gate cannot see them, so a run on a tree whose only note is in the first layout runs its check as it did before notes existed.

compatibility.detail: Notes written by older publishers (refs/notes/evidence/<record>) stay readable by the verifier but are not fetched by the gate or the signed-tree job. Older verifiers cannot read the new refs (they only list the first layout).

manual.detail: No manual step in this change; the cleanup of existing notes is scripts/evidence-gc.

recovery.detail: Reverting restores the first layout for new notes; existing refs of either layout are never rewritten by this change.
